Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
孟子小的时候，从早到晚都跟朋友玩。孟子和他的朋友喜欢玩在墓地里，装祭拜。孟子五岁的时候，跟妈妈搬家。他们搬家不是因为孟子玩得太多，而是因为妈妈认为他们的家离墓地太近。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 孟子小的时候：better to briefly introduce “孟子” when this character first appears
- 孟子和他的朋友喜欢玩在墓地里，装祭拜：在墓地玩，在Place V.; 装着祭拜的样子

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 喜欢玩在墓地里：喜欢在墓地里玩，A location phrase with 在 should come before the main verb 玩.
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 装祭拜：假装祭拜，装 cannot directly introduce the action being imitated here; 假装 is the verb used before an action to mean “pretend to do it.”
3. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 孟子小的时候：有一个小男孩叫孟子。孟子小的时候，This is a first mention, so introduce the character with a noun phrase that identifies who he is before continuing with his name.
4. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 孟子和他的朋友喜欢在墓地里玩：他和他的朋友喜欢在墓地里玩，Use a pronoun for a close re-occurrence: 孟子 was the subject of the immediately preceding sentence, and no competing male character has been introduced.
5. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 跟妈妈搬家：跟妈妈搬了家，Use 了 for the completed action of moving house in this past narrative event.

items.reason: 地点短语“在墓地里”应放在动作“玩”之前。
“装”不能这样直接搭配动作，“假装祭拜”是正确的说法。
首次出现人物需要先作介绍，但改后“孟子小的时候，”仍以逗号结尾，缺少后续谓语。
孟子刚在前一句出现，按参考规则此处应使用近距离回指代词“他”。
搬家是叙事中完成的事件，应说“搬了家”。
